description: Provide trustworthy run results and durable, consumer-neutral agent workflow composition

requirements.description: Keep each Run atomic while exposing a separate durable, explainable RunResult and a consumer-neutral WorkflowExecution that reconciles scenario-owned definitions; requires provider-aware final-output abstention, one schema-validated structured-result mechanism, explicit fresh-run or named-continuation identity per agent node with node-local profiles, deterministic size-bounded append-only journal context, a closed node vocabulary, positive traversal caps on every cycle-forming edge, finite execution budgets, restart-safe dispatch idempotency, and typed terminal outcomes without consumer-domain mutations
requirements.title: Atomic Runs and Durable Workflow Executions

validation.notes: Verify deterministic parsing, schema validation, bounded extraction fallback, abstention, and redacted diagnostics
Verify structured results attach to the canonical Run projection before repository persistence
Verify fresh Run identity per loop attempt, explicit named continuation, bounded bindings, safe CEL, budget exhaustion, and restart-safe idempotent dispatch

Verify metadata-only operator projections, explicit payload authorization, bounded execution history, generated workflow controls, CLI parity, lifecycle WebSocket parsing, and workflow safety ceilings

title: Reliable Results and Agent Workflow Runtime
